audit.whatIsWrong: Sixteen fields called Taliyah 'he/his'. The difficulty framing also never named what actually makes the lane hard.
audit.why: Taliyah is female. The hard part is that her E punishes the exact tool Kassadin escapes with.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed; difficulty now anchored to Unraveled Earth.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].side and phases[5].side read 'Skill' while packet levelChart and content win[4]/win[5] read Taliyah then Kassadin.
audit.why: Packet and content layer agree; the full layer was stale.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side -> Taliyah, phases[5].side -> Kassadin, whys rewritten to match. win[N] already correct, so the pair agrees.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere states that Unraveled Earth stuns anything that DASHES through it — meaning it stuns Riftwalk, your entire escape and engage plan.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them.' Riftwalk is flagged dash.
audit.corrected: Stated in tldr, winCon, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.carry, dontsFull and phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) and the packet flags zero sequencing cues in the whole matchup.
audit.why: Unraveled Earth is a flat 14s, Seismic Shove 14/12.5/11/9.5/8, Threaded Volley 7/6/5/4/3, Weaver's Wall 180/150/120.
audit.corrected: Real numbers plus an explicit wait-then-go line written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim; dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim.
audit.why: Bodies did not match their titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[6].why and breakdown.late credit Kassadin with a silence.
audit.why: Null Sphere interrupts channels per Riot's text; no silence appears in the kit file.

edits.before: - Taliyah Seismic Shove: matchup-defining — The shove into Unraveled Earth is her whole setup — sidestep it and the burst whiffs. It governs your forward steps. - R Riftwalk spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Unraveled Earth is a flat 14s minefield and it STUNS anything that dashes through — wait the 14s out before you Riftwalk at her. - Seismic Shove is 14s at rank 1 and free at rank 5. - Threaded Volley falls to a 3s cooldown, so the poke never stops.

edits.before: Carry through inevitability — no champion converts time into power like Kassadin; your job is making the clock run.

edits.after: If Taliyah takes first blood, tighten up: assume Unraveled Earth is seeded on every path you would blink through. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with W refunds and let 16 arrive.

notes: The kit file's derived flags mark Threaded Volley (Q) and Seismic Shove (W) as 'grounding'. Riot's own descriptions for both mention no grounding — per the brief's rule I trusted the description and asserted grounding NOWHERE, even though it would have been the strongest anti-Riftwalk line available. Flagging it as a probable tooltip-parse misfire. Everything I did write about denying Riftwalk comes from Unraveled Earth's explicit dash-stun text, which is safe. spikes[0].text says the shove-into-E combo 'roots' you — Riot's text says stun, not root; left alone because the fix needs a length-matched rewrite I could not make without touching the surrounding claim.
